# VoiceAct Solutions

> VoiceAct Solutions is a technology-focused business that designs and develops modern web applications, mobile apps, UI/UX design, and custom digital solutions for businesses, startups, and new ideas.

## Key Facts

- Legal name: VoiceAct Solutions
- Website: https://voiceact.tech
- Primary contact: hello@voiceact.tech
- Support: support@voiceact.tech
- Phone: +91 9304922632
- Service area: India; remote engagements worldwide

## Services

- [Web Application Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/web-development): Modern Next.js, React, and TypeScript applications built for performance, SEO, and maintainability.
- [Mobile App Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/mobile-development): Cross-platform iOS and Android apps from a single React Native codebase, with native modules where needed.
- [SaaS Development](https://voiceact.tech/services/saas-development): Multi-tenant SaaS platforms with authentication, billing, and observability built in.
- [UI/UX Design](https://voiceact.tech/services/ui-ux-design): User research, wireframing, and design systems that translate directly into production code.
- [AI Solutions and Integrations](https://voiceact.tech/services/ai-solutions): LLM integrations, RAG pipelines, and AI-powered product features.
- [Cloud and DevOps](https://voiceact.tech/services/cloud-solutions): AWS, Cloudflare, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and production observability.

## Hire Developers

- [Hire React Developers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/react-developers): Component libraries, SPAs, Next.js migration, and performance work.
- [Hire Next.js Developers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/nextjs-developers): App Router, React Server Components, ISR, edge functions, and SEO.
- [Hire React Native Developers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/react-native-developers): iOS and Android from a single TypeScript codebase.
- [Hire AI Engineers](https://voiceact.tech/hire/ai-engineers): LLM integration, RAG pipelines, agent workflows, and vector search.

## Approach

- Engagement model: Scoped discovery, then iterative build and shipping.
- Communication: Direct contact with the people building the product.
- Onboarding: Discovery → Design → Build → Launch → Iterate.

## Technology Stack

- Frontend: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS.
- Backend and APIs: Node.js, REST, GraphQL, tRPC.
- Databases: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Prisma.
- Mobile: React Native.
- AI: OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, vector databases.
- DevOps and Cloud: Docker, AWS, Cloudflare, Vercel, GitHub Actions.
